concerns.text: The plan states: *“If raw profilometry files are missing, verify that existing roughness columns in the OpenML file are statistically comparable to pySurf‑derived values using a Kolmogorov‑Smirnov test (p > 0.05); abort if KS test fails.”* However, when raw files are absent there are no pySurf‑derived values to compare against, making the KS test impossible. This constitutes a methodological flaw (category error) rather than a valid validation step.
